l1_goal.claim: Player = green box with WHITE dot; move it onto charcoal hollow frame to complete level. Black-dot boxes inert.

l1_grid.claim: Cell=3px; 1 arrow move=1 cell=3px. Charcoal frames non-solid. Purple wall blocks player. Bottom row=step bar shrinking 1/action.

l1_mouse.claim: MOUSE click on a green box swaps white player-dot onto that box (old player becomes black-dot box).

l2_goal.claim: L2: 4 boxes (1x1,1x2,2x1,2x2) each must exactly cover matching-size frame interior; filling 1 frame gave no win -> likely all 4.

l2_push.claim: Pushed box slides until blocked, stopping where it first overlaps a frame border pixel. Clicking a box then arrow-moving steps 1 cell, so exact frame placement needs click+step.

l2_result.claim: L2 solved by covering ALL 4 frame interiors with matching-size boxes (click box->arrow-step 1 cell each). Clicks often misflagged no_op.

l3_board.claim: L3: player=1x1 green; 2 yellow plus boxes (45px 9x9); frames: 2 plus (interior 45px) + one 3x3-cell square frame with no matching box.

l3_result.claim: L3 solved: pushed box slides until it SNAPS exactly into a matching frame interior; player(1x1) must also sit in the small 1-cell frame. Yellow boxes NOT clickable.

l4_result.claim: L4 solved: all 3 frames covered (plus box caught into plus frame via CATCH rule; 2 green boxes into 2 small frames, one walked by player after click-swap).

push_rules.claim: Pushed box slides up to 5 cells; stops early if it exactly matches a same-shape frame interior (CATCH); cannot rest overlapping purple band (slides until clear). Player blocked by purple; boxes pass through.
